Measure training time, images/s and VRAM and full decode/preprocess/encoder/packing/native-search/image-to-top-k p50/p95/p99 and QPS at batch1 and batch32, same hardware and query/gallery. A p99 product claim needs 10,000 interleaved paired calls and a confidence interval. Run GPU work only on authenticated DGX Spark after cheaper local/CPU falsifiers, with raw receipts and cost. Use Opus 5.5 plus GPT-6 Astra for consequential critique and Fable for truly new research, without duplicate jobs. If either quality or speed fails, change the responsible layer and stop negative arms early. Within 24 hours push a substantive library/training increment and concise verified decision table with datasets, splits, controls, quality, speed, uncertainty and next gate; continue until the production joint quality-and-speed target is met.
